title: A clear path from discovery to delivery
subtitle: An illustrative technical and commercial proposal for a booking platform.
status: Illustrative draft — not a binding offer

sections.title: Project understanding
sections.intro: Bring service discovery, availability and booking confirmation into one clear journey. This is an illustrative project, not an agreed client brief.

items.title: D01 / UX design
items.body: Design service selection, availability and confirmation screens with responsive layouts.
bullets: Acceptance: approved screens include error and success states.

items.title: D02 / Booking platform
items.body: Implement service listings, availability, booking and administration.
bullets: Acceptance: valid bookings succeed and unavailable slots cannot be booked.

items.title: D03 / Handover and training
items.body: Deliver source files, a short guide and an administration walkthrough.
bullets: Acceptance: an administrator can review and update a booking using the guide.

chart.title: Main deliverables by workstream
chart.note: Counts D01–D03 only; this is not a cost or effort allocation.

diagram.title: Components and relationships
diagram.note: Proposed architecture, subject to requirements approval.

timeline.title: Phases and review gates

phases.title: Discovery and approval
phases.description: Confirm requirements, booking rules and approved screens.

phases.title: Design and development
phases.description: Implement approved scope after client dependencies are available.

phases.title: Testing and handover
phases.description: Verify acceptance criteria, deliver files and provide training.

timeline.note: Sequence is illustrative. Dates and durations await project agreement.

sections.title: Assumptions and exclusions
bullets: Client supplies approved content, service information and booking rules.
Payment integration and native mobile apps are excluded from the base scope.
Timeline, pricing, hosting and ongoing support await confirmation.

sections.title: Next steps
sections.intro: Confirm booking rules, roles and integrations before approving scope, schedule and commercial terms.

pricing.note: Each project is priced individually. No amounts have been approved for this illustration.
